identity.statusNote: affinity.serif.com/photo now redirects (301) to affinity.studio/photo-editing-software, reflecting the 2024 Canva acquisition and the app becoming free.

limits.en: All core photo editing tools free with a Canva account; AI tools require a Canva premium plan

keyLimits.en: Full core editing app free; AI features (Generative Fill/Expand, Smart Selections, Colorize, Super Resolve) gated behind Canva premium

addOns.en: Canva premium subscription unlocks AI Studio tools inside Affinity Photo (price shared with Canva's own plans, not itemized on this page)

cautions.en: The app itself is entirely free since the 2024 Canva acquisition; only advanced AI features require a separate Canva premium subscription, whose price is not shown on the Affinity page itself.

capabilities.en: Non-destructive, reversible editing with layer-based compositing (unlimited raster, vector and text layers)
RAW development with lens correction and noise reduction, plus HDR Merge, Focus Merge and astrophotography stacking
Advanced retouching (frequency separation, liquify), refine-edge selections and 30+ blend modes
Batch processing and macro automation, high-bit-depth workflow with ICC profile support

limitations.en: PSD import can flatten smart objects and advanced Photoshop filters
Exporting to Photoshop does not preserve editability; must save as PDF or PNG instead
AI tools (Generative Fill/Expand, Super Resolve, etc.) require a paid Canva premium account

reason.en: The main paid subscription alternative for professional raster photo editing.
Competes for RAW development and photo cataloguing workflows.
Premium RAW editing and color-grading alternative aimed at professional photographers.

unknowns: iPad app pricing/availability not confirmed on the page fetched (only macOS and Windows explicitly mentioned)
Exact price of the Canva premium plan required for AI features not shown on this page
